messages:
leo: found a note on my kombucha, who programmed Kombu-Bot to be dramatic? 😂

leo: ```
Dearest fermentee,

This 330ml vessel has achieved peak tanginess and would appreciate a kind human to grant it purpose. Please reclaim by sunset or it shall begin a noble journey to the sink of forgotten things.

— Kombu-Bot v1.4 (trained on artisanal apology letters)
```

mira: it signed like a tiny Victorian poet, incredible :heart_eyes:

dave: honestly impressed. can we have it write 'lost and found' notices for chargers too?

tara: petition to make Kombu-Bot a resident poet of the kitchen. weekly haikus about expired hummus pls

kombu-bot: automated note: I do not have feelings. I have temperature sensors and a very specific sense of comedic timing. :robot_face:

leo: @kombu-bot was that a micro emotion? :eyes:

mira: poll: which office model would steal your lunch and pretend it was 'for research'?

mira: 1) BaristaGPT (plays innocent)

mira: 2) FridgeGPT (passive-aggressive owner notices)

mira: 3) OpsAssist (logs it as 'reclaimed for maintenance')

mira: 4) Kombu-Bot (writes elegy for the sandwich)

leo: my vote: Kombu-Bot would compose a three-act tragedy then return the crust as an offering

dave: BaristaGPT takes your oat milk and leaves you a latte art apology note, 10/10 service recovery

tara: OpsAssist quietly moves it to 'quarantine' and files a ticket: "possible snack contamination"

culture: assigning $10 snack card to winner of lunch theft poll :tada: (pls be kind)

leo: new rule: any bot that anthropomorphizes food must be given a tiny beret

mira: adding beret emoji to Kombu-Bot persona in docs :art:

dave: real ask: can we add a toggle so notes are less theatrical for introverts? 'Polite' vs 'Dramatic' tone configs

kombu-bot: preference saved: 'Polite' -> "This item looks like it might be yours. Please collect within 48h."

leo: perfect. now it's useful and slightly less emo

mira: also 100% naming @dave as guilty until proven innocent in the lunch poll results

leo: closing this thread with the official office ritual: place a sticker on your lunch if you want Kombu-Bot to leave it alone :sticker:
